argument: Ward of Iron hands out +1, +2 and +3 DR against one strike, and that ladder is legal: three Energy ranks cover a grant of three under the owner chapter's ranks rule (16-armor-shields.qmd:31). What breaks is the Strong line, which states a four-point figure twice, once as damage landing on the striker and once as a mirror of the same blow (11-arcane-spells:498). A Master card owns the 7/10/14 row, so four sits three under the floor and four is the Novice row's first value, not this card's. It is also one number written as two clauses, so a table reading it may resolve either one instance or two, and nothing on the card says which. Arithmetic: 7 - 4 = 3 short of the Master floor. Fix path: take the reflected figure off the card's own row, or use the sanctioned tier bump instead of a flat number. Disposition: MECHANICAL.

evidence.claim: The Strong outcome names four points of damage twice in one sentence, once against the attacker and once as a mirror of the blow (11-arcane-spells:498).
Master row 7/10/14 against the printed 4: 7 - 4 = 3 under the floor, and 4 is the Novice row's first value (11-arcane-spells:498).
A grant of three needs three ranks, and the card asks for three Energy, so the DR part of the ladder is compliant (16-armor-shields.qmd:31).
